Messages.Body:
Hi,

A has a Meat Hook and strikes with it.

When is the check for the optional press made - Is it
a/ after strike declaration ?
b/ after strike resolution ?
c/ during the press step ?

This matters for cases where the opposing vampire burns the Meat Hook

Thanks,
Pascal.

~~

Meat Hook
Cardtype: Equipment
Melee weapon.
Strike: strength+1 damage, only usable once each round. Once each
combat, if this weapon is used to strike at close range and the
opponent doesn't dodge the strike, the bearer gets an optional press
this round, only usable to continue combat. At close range, a vampire
with Potence [pot] may destroy this weapon as a strike with first
strike that costs 1 blood.

> the hook is used at close range, then the bearer gets an optional

If someone strikes to destroy the weapon with first strike and is
successful, I'm confused about why the former bearer of the hook gets
a press.

For example-
Minion A: Strike with hook
Minion B: Strike to destroy hook w/first strike

Resolution
Minion B: First strike resolves before regular strikes, so the weapon
burns.
Minion A: Would hit minion B with hook, but the hook is gone. No
strike? Re-choose strike?

I suspect I'm wrong about one or more parts of this, please release me
from my ignorance ;)

Brandon

>
> If someone strikes to destroy the weapon with first strike and is
> successful, I'm confused about why the former bearer of the hook gets
> a press.

My understanding of LSJ's answer is that he's given the optional press
after strike declaration, and before strike resolution. The "check" I
was talking about is the "If the opposing minion doesn't dodge the
strike" part. After strike declaration, the weapon is used, but since
we're not yet at strike resolution, it is still in play.

> For example-
> Minion A: Strike with hook
> Minion B: Strike to destroy hook w/first strike
>
> Resolution
> Minion B: First strike resolves before regular strikes, so the weapon
> burns.
> Minion A: Would hit minion B with hook, but the hook is gone. No
> strike? Re-choose strike?

No strike. See also Aid from Bats vs Immortal Grapple.

> If the meat hook gets Fast Hands, does the other minion get a press
> now? Even though that minion didn't use the Hook, the other minion did

No.

A: strike Meat Hook.
B: strike Fast Hands, stealing Meat Hook (not at first strike)

resolve:

Meat Hook and Fast Hands resolve simultaneously.

A gains a press, B gains a Meat Hook and some damage.
